rules: Tracks accepted and rejected model candidates for opportunity-cost diagnostics and shadow-first profitability admission.
Uses future Alpaca daily bars only after the decision date; never uses future data to create the decision.
Shadow evidence may unlock reduced-size live probation only after configured sample/expectancy thresholds; it may never automatically increase maximum live risk or loosen a hard gate.
Robinhood real-fill history remains authoritative for actual-money performance and full admission.
